newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania January foreign debt $1.175 billion.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania January foreign debt $1.175 billion.

text.p: Lithuania's foreign currency debt fell slightly to $1.175 billion in January from $1.20 billion at the end of December 1996, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
Foreign debt amounted to 13.45 percent of gross domestic product (GDP), the ministry said in a statement.
The statement added that $882 million of the debt was borrowed in the state's name and another $294 million with guarantees from the government.

The finance ministry said that from 1990 to end January this year the country borrowed a total $1.4 billion and has paid back some $224.4 million between 1993 and January 1997. -- Andrius Vilkancas, Vilnius newsroom - 370 2 22 35 17.
